result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with marked crosswalks and traffic signals, but it lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and curb ramps. The environment is dominated by wide asphalt surfaces and multi-lane traffic, with minimal physical separation between pedestrians and vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk at the corner has a vertical curb with no ramp, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground right corner of the intersection

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While there are traffic lights for vehicles, there are no visible pedestrian-specific signal heads to indicate when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the intersection on the signal mast arms

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway and lack of a median or refuge island increase the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install directional curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear timing information for people crossing the street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a residential/commercial intersection with marked high-visibility crosswalks and sidewalks. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide turning radii and lack of physical protection or signalization for pedestrians increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may obstruct sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the street near the intersection

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

interventions.title: Raised Intersection or Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crossing to the level of the sidewalk to slow traffic and increase pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical pedestrian protection like refuge islands or curb extensions increase exposure risk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Daylighting

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with marked crosswalks and sidewalks, but significant pedestrian exposure due to the large crossing distance and lack of a refuge island. The environment is characterized by mixed-use buildings and multiple lanes of traffic, including a large pickup truck currently occupying the intersection.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Presence
hazards.description: A large pickup truck is positioned near the crosswalk, which can create blind spots and increase the severity of potential impacts.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse markings to continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility to approaching drivers.
